question: Identify the long name of the team that, during the 2015/2016 season, had the most draws in its home matches among teams whose build-up play dribbling class is 'Normal' and whose build-up play speed in 2015 was below the average for such teams.

prediction.sql:
SELECT t.XCL_173
FROM Team t
INNER JOIN Match m ON t.XCL_171 = m.XCL_013
INNER JOIN Team_Attributes ta ON t.XCL_171 = ta.XCL_177
WHERE m.XCL_009 = '2015/2016'
  AND m.XCL_015 = m.XCL_016
  AND ta.XCL_182 = 'Normal'
  AND ta.XCL_180 < (
    SELECT AVG(ta2.XCL_180)
    FROM Team_Attributes ta2
    WHERE ta2.XCL_182 = 'Normal'
      AND SUBSTR(ta2.XCL_178, 1, 4) = '2015'
  )
  AND SUBSTR(ta.XCL_178, 1, 4) = '2015'
GROUP BY t.XCL_171
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1
